nativeRoute: Firmware native SSO browser cookie token → token HTTP header

loginFlow.steps: 复用 FIRMWARE_MGR_TOKEN/FIRMWARE_MGR_TEST_TOKEN；缺失由用户在正确域网页 SSO 登录，宿主安全注入 token cookie 到进程变量，禁止 echo/聊天索要明文。现有契约没有证明 IdP 是 Casdoor。
loginFlow.authorization: Login, token creation/rotation/revocation and business writes require the current task scope; this discovery performs none.

tokenMechanism: token header（不是 Authorization Bearer）；Cookie 本身不足 API 认证；所有业务 POST JSON {}。
subjectPermission: POST /api/get_models 或 get_versions，result=0 是有效凭据/该读取权限；不能当稳定 subject 证明。get_user_info 既有 header/body bug 不能直接作探针。admin/developer/product 权限单独核验。
expiryRevoke: result 10001/no auth 失效或权限不足；不盲重试；expiry/revoke 与稳定 subject 字段待源码/部署确认。

versionPolicy.rule: Candidate source and published contracts do not establish deployed compatibility. Verify the target instance version and read-only supported capabilities before enabling an adapter.

verification.scope: Read-only documentation/repository discovery; no login, token issuance, credential inspection or business API execution.
